definitions.gloss: recipient; receiving party; place of receipt
definitions.explanation: The person, company, or location that receives goods, money, or a delivery. A form-filling and business term rather than conversational vocabulary.

examples.japanese: {受取先|うけとりさき}を{記入|きにゅう}してください。
{受取先|うけとりさき}をコンビニに{変更|へんこう}した。
examples.english: I changed the pickup location to a convenience store.

examples.japanese: {受取先|うけとりさき}の{住所|じゅうしょ}が{間違|まちが}っていたため、{荷物|にもつ}が{戻|もど}ってきてしまった。
examples.english: The recipient's address was wrong, so the package came back.

notes:
Formed from {受|う}け{取|と}る (to receive) plus 〜{先|さき}, the suffix that names the other party or destination of an action.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {受取先|うけとりさき}{住所|じゅうしょ}: recipient's address
- {受取先|うけとりさき}を{指定|してい}する: to specify the recipient
- {受取先|うけとりさき}{変更|へんこう}: change of recipient

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {送|おく}り{先|さき}: destination for sending — the same delivery seen from the sender's side
- {宛先|あてさき}: addressee — the address written on the item itself
- {取引先|とりひきさき}: business partner — a parallel 〜{先|さき} compound worth learning alongside this one
